title: Circuit encoding and decoding
statement: For every Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ variables, every fuel bound $f$, and every Boolean list $r$, if the length of the encoding of $C$ is at most $f$, then reading the encoded circuit followed by $r$ with fuel $f$ returns exactly $C$ and leaves $r$ unread.
hypotheses_covered: A circuit C on n variables
Fuel f is a natural number
Suffix r is a list of Boolean values
The encoding of C has length at most f
